name: OpenSubtitles
description: Finds and downloads missing subtitles from OpenSubtitles.com — from the player's subtitle menu, or automatically for new titles.
author: Atomix

settings.label: API key
settings.help: Free: sign in at opensubtitles.com, open your profile → API consumers → create one.

settings.label: OpenSubtitles username (optional)
settings.help: Without an account you can download 5 subtitles a day; signing in raises that limit.

settings.label: Languages
settings.help: Comma-separated codes, e.g. en,mi,fr. Used for automatic downloads and as the default search.

settings.label: Automatically download subtitles for newly added titles
Prefer hearing-impaired (SDH) subtitles for automatic downloads
